## Plugin reference

- Description: Keyboard Party's stage: every key plays its own animation and sound (letters bring a picture, a word and speech; digits count; space, Enter, arrows, Backspace and modifiers each have their own effect), with a bead trail of recent keys, a full-screen keyboard lock and the party settings. Server registration of the Keyboard Party config.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `ConfigV2.WebRegister` "config"
  - Uses:
    - `config_v2.ConfigV2`
    - `config_v2.useConfig`
    - `config_v2.useSetConfig`
    - `config_v2/fields.FieldRenderer`
    - `primitives/css/control-panel.ControlPanelPopover`
    - `primitives/icon-button.IconButton`
  - Exports (values): `PartyStage`
- Server:
  - Contributes: `ConfigV2.Register` "config"
  - Uses: `config_v2.ConfigV2`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `config_v2.defineConfig`
    - `fields/bool/config.boolField`
    - `fields/enum/config.enumField`
  - Exports (types):
    - `Direction`
    - `Entrance`
    - `Instrument`
    - `KeyEffect`
  - Exports (values):
    - `beadLabel`
    - `classifyKey`
    - `COUNT_PICTURES`
    - `ENTRANCES`
    - `hueOf`
    - `INSTRUMENTS`
    - `LETTER_WORDS`
    - `NUMBER_WORDS`
    - `partyConfig`
    - `pentatonicHz`
- Cross-plugin:
